maddeler.e:
اكتتبوا (form VIII)
# اِكْتَتَبُوا (iktatabū) /ik.ta.ta.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِكْتَتَبَ (iktataba)
# اُكْتُتِبُوا (uktutibū) /uk.tu.ti.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِكْتَتَبَ (iktataba)
# اِكْتَتِبُوا (iktatibū) /ik.ta.ti.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِكْتَتَبَ (iktataba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
